tools.name: GenerateVisitorToken
tools.description:
Create a new visitor session and obtain a visitor access token for site "OhGiftPlease" (https://www.ohgiftplease.com/_api/mcp).
You must use this tool before calling CallWixSiteAPI for this first time.
If you already have a visitor token in your context, DO NOT USE THIS TOOL AGAIN.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, ExecuteWixAPI.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, ExecuteWixAPI

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
